name: Clay
product: Clay brings prospect data, buying signals and AI research into GTM workflows.
opportunity: Turn intent into a fast, accountable marketing-to-SDR handoff.
hypothesis: A qualified signal loses value when enrichment, ownership and follow-up happen in separate queues. A shared signal-to-meeting workflow could expose that delay and help the team improve it.
automations: Research a signal with source links before scoring.
Flag stale or conflicting records for human review.
Notify an owner when the follow-up SLA is at risk.
roadmap: Map the current inbound funnel, definitions, ownership and a baseline speed-to-lead.
Pilot a sourced intent and enrichment workflow with one marketing and SDR segment.
Compare accepted meetings and conversion by source; refine scoring with frontline feedback.
fit: A local partnership CRM with contact provenance and pipeline stages, source-backed extraction, and enterprise outbound experience connect data quality to a real sales handoff.
